mechanics.summary: Blizzard announced a 30% reduction to health and damage of all Firelands bosses and other enemies at 4.4.2 launch, implemented by Power of Stormrage; General Taldris Moonfall can deactivate it.
Alysrazor is boss entry 52530 in Firelands map 720, encounter slot DATA_ALYSRAZOR=3. The local loader registers only Alysrazor trash/cosmetic scripts, not a boss AI.
Current guides report a roleplay opening with Firestorm, knockback, and Volcanic Fire/ground strafe pressure.
Guides report alternating pairs of Blazing Talon Initiates, Brushfire, and interruptible Fieroblast with Fire It Up stacks.
Two Molten Eggs are reported per set; Voracious Hatchlings hatch shortly afterward, Imprint a nearby/closest player, then become Hungry and can Tantrum until fed.
Guides report rotating cone control by Plump Lava Worms, with Gushing Wound and Lava Spew creating ground-team constraints.
Up to three Molten Feathers are reported; the third grants Wings of Flame. Flight players collect rings to refresh flight and build Blazing Power.
Blazing Power is reported as haste per stack up to 25 stacks; the cap grants Alysra's Razor critical-strike benefit.
Phase 2 is reported to create a Fiery Vortex followed by five Fiery Tornados in an outer ring; current Classic guidance describes slower tornado behavior.

values.reported_phase_two_entry: after Phase 1 interval; exact duration conflicts

mechanics.summary: After the tornado phase, guides report Burnout, a Spark, and two Blazing Talon Clawshapers whose Ignition restores Alysrazor's energy unless interrupted.
At 50 reported Molten Power, Alysrazor becomes grounded and uses Blazing Claw, Blazing Buffet, and Full Power; a third cycle is reported as permanent ground.

values.claw_vulnerability: 10% physical/fire damage taken for15s per stack reported

mechanics.summary: Heroic guidance reports Molten Meteors during Phase 1; the meteor rolls, splits against the wall, and provides a cover/kill mechanic for Firestorm.
The local C++ proves only Alysrazor trash/cosmetic behavior; these timers must not be substituted for boss phase timers.

known_behavior_summary: Current guides agree on the flight/ground concept, four-phase loop, rings, Blazing Power, and grounded final burn. They disagree or omit build-sensitive timing, scaling, altitude, target, and modifier-state details. The local checkout has no Alysrazor boss AI, so no guide mechanic is executable evidence.

phase_reset_credit.behavior: Firelands is a seven-boss 10/25 normal/heroic raid; no Alysrazor-specific unlock event is implemented locally.
Header/instance mapping identifies entry52530 and slot DATA_ALYSRAZOR, but the loaded script contains no boss AI or engage handler.
Guide-described Phase 1 flight, Phase 2 tornado, Phase 3 Burnout, and Phase 4 ground loop; no local transition handler.
No Alysrazor Reset/EnterEvade/add-cleanup implementation; only trash scripts have local respawn/despawn behavior.
No local Alysrazor JustDied, loot, achievement, lockout, or player-credit handler; historical encounter row1206 is identity only.
All four endpoints are in scope. Heroic Hatchling/Meteor/worm deltas are guide observations; exact normal/heroic and 10/25 coefficients are unresolved.
Official announcement supplies -30% health/-30% damage for all Firelands bosses and other enemies with optional deactivation; no local aura/NPC/default-state implementation.
